buckets.hint: What is on the desk for this one call.
buckets.label: The window

buckets.hint: A record of one session, kept for reading later.
buckets.label: The session log

buckets.hint: Standing facts about the repository, read by every run in it.

buckets.hint: Facts kept across projects, looked up when needed.

items.text: The tool results of the current call
items.why: They are on the desk now. They are not kept once the call is over unless something writes them down.

items.text: The commands run in yesterday's session
items.why: A session log records what one session did, so the next session can read it.
Standing facts about one repository belong in its project files, where every run reads them.

items.text: A note that a user prefers short answers
items.why: A fact about a person that applies across projects belongs in the long-term store.

items.text: The summary of the story so far, after a compaction
items.why: It is on the desk for the next calls. It is not a file, so a new session does not see it.

items.text: The handoff note a clean reset writes
items.why: A handoff note written to a file is read by the next run; the window is cleared at the reset.

prompt: Sort each kind of memory into its tier.
